beats.text: The United States spends 16.7% of its economy on health. Laos spends 1.3%.
That gives the United States the highest healthcare spending share on Earth.
Compare that to India, which spends 3.3% of its economy on health.
This counts healthcare goods and services consumed, excluding capital costs like buildings and machinery.
Near the top, Afghanistan spends 15%, Germany spends 12.3%, and the UK spends 11.1%.
At the very bottom sits Laos, spending just 1.3%.
How much of your nation's economy goes to healthcare?
